info.title: fx 0.8.1 · Your repositories as one space: for people, for CI and for agents.
info.description: fx, the tool of Fuxion's spaces: what they mount, the shared build of .NET (with Fuxion.Tool.Sdk), the instructions for the coding agents and the versions, from the configuration in _fx/. A native executable for each platform.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: fx ui · the space in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a mount to mounts.yaml, where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.

options.name: --root
options.description: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

options.name: --space
options.description: Act on the nearest space that mounts others, itself included, from anywhere inside it.

options.name: --output
options.description: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More detail, on stderr.

options.name: --plain
options.description: No colors or borders.

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).

commands.name: list
commands.description: The mounts of mounts.yaml: where, their mode, whether they are required and whether they are here.

commands.name: park
commands.description: Park mounts: their clones go to _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Fast-forward the mounts here that have a clean working tree.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Take a mount out of mounts.yaml; its clone stays.

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename a mount: its references in this space change, and the old name stays in aliases.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Change a key of a mount: url, path, required, mode, depends-on or inherits.

commands.name: status
commands.description: The mounts here that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.

commands.name: tag
commands.description: Add tags to a mount, or remove them (--remove).

commands.name: unpark
commands.description: Unpark mounts: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.
